description: Defines data structures and enums for tracking underrun status and dump state of FastMixer in Android audio system, including FastTrackUnderrunStatus enum, FastTrackUnderruns union, FastTrackDump struct, and FastMixerDumpState class.

classes.name: FastTrackUnderruns
classes.description: Union representing underrun counters and status for a fast track, with atomic access.

classes.name: FastTrackDump
classes.description: Struct representing the dump state of a fast track, including underruns, frames ready, and frames written.

classes.name: FastMixerDumpState
classes.description: Class inheriting from FastThreadDumpState, encapsulating dump information for the FastMixer, including timestamp verification.

methods.name: FastTrackUnderruns()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the underruns union to zero.

methods.name: FastTrackDump()
methods.description: Constructor for FastTrackDump, initializes mFramesReady to zero.

methods.name: dump(int fd) const
methods.description: Method to dump the state to a file descriptor.
